cities.name: Belgrade
cities.local_food_tip: Try Serbian pastries, gibanica, prebranac, grilled vegetables and mild soups — comforting and widely vegetarian-friendly.
cities.full_day: Morning: Kalemegdan Fortress → Victor Monument → Military Museum exterior → Walk down Knez Mihailova → Chill at Republic Square cafés. Afternoon: Explore Skadarlija's cobblestone charm → Serbian-style lunch (traditional or veggie-friendly) → Visit Nikola Tesla Museum → Walk around St. Sava Temple square. Sunset: Head to Zemun Gardoš Tower for golden-hour city views. Night: Riverfront stroll through Savamala & Beton Hala with non-alcoholic drink spots.
public_transport_tips: Buses and trams reach all major areas.
Old Town is entirely walkable.
Taxis and apps work reliably across the city.
Trams give great river views on some routes.

cities.name: Novi Sad
cities.local_food_tip: Try Vojvodinian soups, štrudla, mild stews and veggie-friendly dishes — warm and homestyle.
cities.full_day: Morning: Liberty Square → Name of Mary Church → Dunavska Street → Quick Museum of Vojvodina visit → Café break in Pašićeva. Afternoon: Cross to Petrovaradin Fortress → Clock Tower viewpoint → Artist ateliers → Vojvodinian-style lunch. Sunset: Golden-hour walk along Štrand or Kej. Night: Zmaj Jovina & Laze Telečkog pedestrian zone with dessert cafés and non-alcoholic options.
public_transport_tips: Buses connect both sides of the Danube easily.
Center and fortress are walkable.
Bike rentals are popular near the river.
Taxis are cheap for short distances.

city_events.name: EXIT Festival
city_events.description: Iconic music festival at Petrovaradin Fortress (family-friendly areas available).

city_events.name: Winter Fest
city_events.description: Large Christmas village on the main square.

cities.name: Subotica
cities.local_food_tip: Try Vojvodina comfort food: fish soups, dumplings, štrudla, pastries and mild vegetarian plates.
cities.full_day: Morning: Explore City Hall & main Art Nouveau square → Visit the Synagogue → Check City Museum → Coffee on Korzo pedestrian zone. Afternoon: Head to Palić Lake → Water Tower & Grand Terrace → Vojvodina lunch → Calm walk in Palić Park. Sunset: Sit by the lake for golden reflections. Night: Relaxed dessert cafés and soft-lit Korzo stroll.

ideas: Ice cream breaks in the center.
Warm colors on Art Nouveau façades.
Museum visits in the old town.

public_transport_tips: Local buses go directly to Palić Lake.
City center is fully walkable.
Bike rentals are easy and cheap.
Taxi rides are short and affordable.

city_events.description: Outdoor cinema vibes by the lake.

city_events.name: Winter Korzo Lights
city_events.description: Soft festive glow and cozy small-town evenings.

cities.name: Sombor
cities.local_food_tip: Try Bačka-style warm dishes: soups, stews, pastries, mild veggie meals and classic northern comfort food.
cities.full_day: Morning: Walk Zelena Ulica → Visit County Hall → Explore Sombor National Museum → Coffee under the linden trees. Afternoon: Wander Sombor City Park → Easy bike ride toward Great Bačka Canal → Traditional Bačka lunch → Visit Konjović Gallery. Sunset: Golden-hour reflections at the canal. Night: Dessert cafés in the center and slow small-town strolling.

ideas: Ice cream on Kralja Petra Street.

locations: Warm dessert cafés for cold evenings.

public_transport_tips: Center is perfect for walking.
Bike rentals are common and cheap.
Buses connect outer areas.
Taxis for quick canal access.

cities.name: Sremski Karlovci
cities.local_food_tip: Try Vojvodina soups, kuglof cake, pastries, mild stews and grape-inspired desserts.
cities.full_day: Morning: Start at the Patriarchate → Branko Radičević Square → Four Lions Fountain → Karlovci Gymnasium courtyard → Café break under old linden trees. Afternoon: Visit the Chapel of Peace → Walk to the vineyards area → Traditional Vojvodinian lunch → Stroll toward the Danube viewpoint. Sunset: Golden hour by the riverbank. Night: Quiet dessert cafés and relaxed small-town evening vibe.
public_transport_tips: Buses run frequently from Novi Sad.
Town center is fully walkable.
Stražilovo reachable by short taxi ride.
Danube viewpoint paths are easy to reach on foot.

cities.name: Novi Pazar
cities.local_food_tip: Try pite, somun-based meals, veggie stews, soups and soft pastries — mild and comforting.
cities.full_day: Morning: Explore Stari Grad fortress remains → Walk through old čaršija streets → Visit Altun-Alem Mosque exterior → Coffee in the bazaar area. Afternoon: Visit Peter's Church (one of the oldest churches in Serbia) → Walk around Novi Pazar Hammam surroundings → Traditional lunch with veggie-friendly options → Light hike toward surrounding hills. Sunset: Viewpoint above the city with warm soft light. Night: Relax in dessert cafés around the center.

ideas: Ice cream in the old bazaar.

locations: Warm dessert houses in the center.

public_transport_tips: Local buses cover main areas.
Old čaršija is best explored on foot.
Taxis are inexpensive for reaching hills.
City is compact for walking.

cities.local_food_tip: Try Šumadija-style soups, baked dishes, pastries and mild stews — simple, warm and homestyle.
cities.full_day: Morning: Begin in the old center → Visit Miloš Palace exterior → Walk to Amidža Konak courtyard → Coffee around the old square. Afternoon: Explore Šumarice Memorial Park → Visit the lake area → Traditional Šumadija lunch → Short city-museum visit. Sunset: Chill around the lake or park edges. Night: Dessert cafés in the pedestrian zone.

cities.name: Leskovac

cities.full_day: Morning: Start at the old center → Visit the National Museum exterior → Walk to Hisar hill base → Coffee in the pedestrian zone. Afternoon: Explore Šop-Đokić House exterior → Leskovac lunch with veggie-friendly sides → Park strolls and relaxed shopping streets. Sunset: Hill viewpoint for warm southern colors. Night: Dessert cafés downtown.
public_transport_tips: Local buses cover major zones.
